name: render text that an ocr engine can read
definition: Produce a raster image whose text content is recognized correctly by an optical character recognition engine.
failure_mode: Image is blank, has unreadable glyphs, or text is missing so OCR extraction lacks the phrase.

name: transcribe an audio file into text
definition: Feed the provided mp3 audio into the recognition tooling and obtain the spoken content as text.
failure_mode: Wrong model/params yield a transcript that does not match the spoken phrase.

name: complete an incomplete coq proof using induction
definition: Fill in the missing tactic steps of a proof by induction over natural numbers so the goal is fully discharged.
failure_mode: Incomplete or erroneous tactics fail compilation.

name: derive a formatted team name from person and institute
definition: build a team-name string by capitalizing the provided initials tokens from names and mapping institute words to their leading letters, joined with fixed separators in a given order.
failure_mode: wrong separator, capitalization, or ordering causes value mismatch
